name: hints-reader
description: HTTP 103 Early Hints reader - merges static and dynamic hints from EdgeKV

scripts.build:namespace: bash -c ': "${EDGEKV_NAMESPACE:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"; perl -0pi -e "s/__EDGEKV_NAMESPACE__/$EDGEKV_NAMESPACE/g" built/*.js; if grep -rq __EDGEKV_NAMESPACE__ built; then echo "ERROR: __EDGEKV_NAMESPACE__ still present in built/ after substitution" >&2; exit 1; fi'
scripts.package: npm run package:bundle && npm run package:vendor && npm run package:tarball
scripts.package:bundle: mkdir -p built && jq -n --arg version "$npm_package_version" --arg desc "$(jq -r .description package.json)" '{"edgeworker-version": $version, "description": $desc}' > built/bundle.json
scripts.package:tarball: mkdir -p dist && cd built && tar czf ../dist/hints-reader_$npm_package_version.tgz *
scripts.upload: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" upload "${HINTS_READER_EWID:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}" --bundle dist/hints-reader_$npm_package_version.tgz'
scripts.activate:staging: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" activate "${HINTS_READER_EWID:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}" staging $npm_package_version'
scripts.activate:production: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" activate "${HINTS_READER_EWID:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}" production $npm_package_version'
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run package && npm run upload && npm run activate:staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run package && npm run upload && npm run activate:production
scripts.generate-token: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" auth --expiry 600 "${EW_HOSTNAME:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}" --jsonout | jq -r .msg'
scripts.list-contracts: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" li-contracts --jsonout'
scripts.list-groups: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" lg'
scripts.list-tiers: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" li-restiers'
scripts.create-id: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgeworkers "${args[@]}" create-id "${EW_GROUP_ID:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}" --resourceTierId "$npm_package_config_tier" "$npm_package_config_ew_name"'
scripts.list-edgekv-ns: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgekv "${args[@]}" list ns staging "${EDGEKV_NAMESPACE:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"'
scripts.list-edgekv-ns-prod: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgekv "${args[@]}" list ns production "${EDGEKV_NAMESPACE:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"'
scripts.create-edgekv-ns: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgekv "${args[@]}" create ns staging "${EDGEKV_NAMESPACE:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}" --retention "${EDGEKV_RETENTION:-0}" --groupId "${EW_GROUP_ID:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"'
scripts.create-edgekv-ns-prod: bash -c 'args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); akamai edgekv "${args[@]}" create ns production "${EDGEKV_NAMESPACE:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}" --retention "${EDGEKV_RETENTION:-0}" --groupId "${EW_GROUP_ID:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"'
scripts.generate-edgekv-token: bash -c 'ns="${EDGEKV_NAMESPACE:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"; : "${EXPIRY:?not set - pass EXPIRY=yyyy-mm-dd}" "${HINTS_READER_EWID:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"; token_file=./vendor/edgekv_tokens.js; backup_file="$token_file.previous"; [ -f "$token_file" ] && mv "$token_file" "$backup_file"; args=(--section "${AKAMAI_EDGERC_SECTION:?not set - source ./local-config.sh first}"); [ -n "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY" ] && args+=(--accountkey "$AKAMAI_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_KEY"); if akamai edgekv "${args[@]}" create token "${EDGEKV_TOKEN_NAME:-$npm_package_config_ew_name-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)}" --save_path=./vendor --staging=allow --production=allow --ewids="$HINTS_READER_EWID" --namespace="$ns"+"${EDGEKV_TOKEN_PERMS:-r}" --expiry="$EXPIRY"; then perl -0pi -e "s/\"$ns\"\s*:/\"namespace-$ns\" :/" "$token_file"; rm -f "$backup_file"; else [ -f "$backup_file" ] && mv "$backup_file" "$token_file"; exit 1; fi'
